title: Can I use AI to create and deploy an Azure Logic Apps with Business Central connector?
summary: AI successfully created and deployed an Azure Logic App with HTTP trigger and Business Central connector integration, but failed to correctly configure the Business Central connector parameters in the workflow definition, requiring manual correction.
key_points: AI autonomously created required Azure resources including resource group, storage account, app service plan, and Logic App instance
AI self-corrected when choosing unsupported Free SKU for app service plan, deleting and recreating with correct configuration
AI deployed an HTTP Request trigger and HTTP Response action correctly as specified
Business Central connector was added with incorrect API connection parameters, preventing proper functionality
Better prompt documentation on Business Central connector parameters could improve AI's ability to generate correct workflow definitions
